instruction: Restore the last tab that was closed.

metadata.explanation: Task variation using e-commerce websites (amazon.com, ebay.com, etsy.com). User needs to undo the closing of the last tab (etsy.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator checks if all 3 tabs are open using the existing is_expected_tabs metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_open_tabs_info) correctly extracts open tab information including URLs
Metric (is_expected_tabs) properly compares expected URLs with actual open tabs using type='url' matching
Expected parameter handling is CORRECT for type='rule' - metric directly accesses rule['type'] and rule['urls'] from the rules dict
Complete instruction coverage - evaluator verifies all 3 tabs (amazon, ebay, etsy) are open, confirming the undo operation succeeded
Expected values are semantically correct - the 3 URLs match the initial setup before etsy.com was closed
Data flow is correct: getter returns List[Dict[str, str]] -> metric receives as open_tabs -> compares URLs using are_lists_equal with compare_urls
Edge cases handled appropriately: empty list returns 0.0, URL comparison uses robust compare_urls function
